items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: I remember making one record one with Faith Marvel Band... One was called Piano. Piano, Flyz

ctx.x: But I remember all those things, you know. all those things you know but I think it was the greatest part of my life playing music all that many years. Yes that's something you never did. Yeah of course we didn't make any money we didn't have a chance to make any money in those days you know. Well by the way I might ask one second about making records do you remember? I remember making one record one with Faith Marvel Band.

That's what I thought there was one old okay record. One record I remember making. One was called Piano. Piano, Flyz and um. Get the other side. I don't have the record anymore. Some people still have it around.

Well that's been so long the bands are just beginning to make records. We made this right down in New Orleans. Right in New Orleans. We went up to the studio. They just began to make the records. Silestam had a fresh record.
